question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5
solution:
The correct answer is '**women**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence refers to the group of illiterate adults, specifying that a majority (two-thirds) are females.
 
• The plural noun "**women**" is appropriate as it agrees with the plural subject “two-thirds of whom.” (महिलाएं)
 
• "**Woman**" is the singular form, which would be grammatically incorrect here.
 
• "**Man**" and "**child**" do not align with the context or the gender-based statistic provided in the passage.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

Complete Passage: *Worldwide illiteracy rates have **consistently**__ declined in the last few decades. One of the major reasons for this decline is the sharp increase in literacy rates __**among**__ young women, which is a result of specific __**campaigns**__ designed to increase educational opportunities for girls. __**However**__, there are still an estimated 771 million illiterate adults in the world, about two-thirds of whom are __**women**__.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Man** – Singular form referring to an adult male. Incorrect in this context.
 
• **Woman** – Singular form of "women". Incorrect due to mismatch with the plural subject.
 
• **Child** – Refers to a young human being; irrelevant in a sentence about adult illiteracy.
